title: CI format gate fails: application_integration_test.gleam unformatted
evidence:
let assert Ok(entry) =
    list.find(response.entries, fn(e) { e.id == app_id })
detail: `gleam format --check` fails on this file. The multi-line `let assert` must be single-line per Gleam's formatter. CI's repo-wide format gate blocks merge.
recommended_fix: Run `gleam format server/test/integration/application_integration_test.gleam` to collapse the let-assert onto one line.

title: Client reducer ApiReturnedStatusUpdate viewed arm lacks client-unit test
detail: The reducer's bespoke string→enum case has a silent `_ -> app.status` fallback. No client test dispatches `ApiReturnedStatusUpdate(Ok("viewed"))`. Integration covers server-side round-trip but not this reducer arm.
recommended_fix: Add a client-unit test dispatching ApiReturnedStatusUpdate(Ok("viewed")) and asserting model.application.status is Viewed.
